job.job_description:
Fractal is looking for a proactive and driven Engagement Manager Decision Science to join our Decision Science Consulting team. In this role, you will help power measurable outcomes for leading technology organizations, leveraging cutting-edge Data Science, Marketing Analyics , GenAI, Engineering, and Behavioral Science capabilities.

This is a perfect opportunity for someone who combines consulting-grade systems thinking, strong problem-solving, effective communication, and thought leadership to help our clients solve their most strategic business problems. The ideal candidate will fit well with our key values i.e. humility to power continuous learning, hunger for constant growth and improvement and smart solutioning leveraging multi-disciplinary skills


Engagement Manager-FPA
Our people make all the difference in our success.
Client Stakeholder Management
This is the most critical skill for an Engagement Manager .
Relationship Management
Build long-term client relationships
Act as the primary point of contact for clients
Understand client business challenges
Executive Communication
Present solutions to senior leadership
Conduct steering committee meetings
Handle escalations and conflict resolution
Expectation Management
Align project outcomes with business expectations
Manage scope changes
Maintain client satisfaction
2. Sales Revenue Generation
Engagement Managers usually carry quarterly or annual revenue targets .
Business Development
Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities
Expand existing client accounts
Generate new project opportunities
Proposal Development
Prepare proposals and RFP responses
Design analytics or consulting solutions
Define pricing and commercial models
Sales Pipeline Management
Track potential deals
Manage lead conversion
Forecast revenue
Typical targets:
Annual revenue target
Account growth percentage
Client retention
3. Project Delivery Management
Engagement Managers ensure projects are delivered successfully and profitably .
Delivery Oversight
Manage multiple projects simultaneously
Ensure quality of deliverables
Monitor budgets and profitability
Resource Management
Allocate consultants and analysts
Balance workload across teams
Manage utilization
Risk Issue Management
Identify delivery risks
Manage project dependencies
Resolve escalations quickly
4. Strategic Consulting Solution Design
Engagement Managers must connect business problems to consulting solutions .
Solution Structuring
Define solution approach
Align analytics strategy with client goals
Design transformation roadmaps
Industry Expertise
Understanding of industries like:
Banking
Retail
Telecom
Healthcare
Technology
Value Creation
Focus on measurable impact such as:
Revenue growth
Cost optimization
Operational efficiency
5. Leadership Team Management
Engagement Managers typically manage multiple consulting teams .
Team Leadership
Manage Senior Consultants and Consultants
Provide mentorship and coaching
Build high-performing teams
Performance Management
Set team goals
Conduct reviews and feedback
Identify training needs
6. Financial Commercial Management
Important for roles with sales targets and profitability goals .
Budget Management
Track project budgets
Control costs
Ensure profit margins
Contract Management
Review client contracts
Ensure deliverables match agreements
Revenue Tracking
Monitor billing
Track account profitability
7. Analytics Technology Understanding
Even though EMs may not be hands-on, they must understand analytics solutions.
Knowledge areas include:
Strong GEN AI Experience
Data analytics and AI solutions
Data platforms and cloud analytics
Data visualization tools
Digital transformation
Common technologies used in engagements:
Power BI / Tableau
Python / SQL
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure)
8. Communication Storytelling
Engagement Managers must communicate value clearly to executives .
Key skills include:
Executive presentations
Data storytelling
Business case development
Strategic recommendations
9. Account Growth Strategy
Engagement Managers focus heavily on account expansion .
Account Planning
Identify new opportunities within existing clients
Map stakeholders within the organization
Long-Term Partnerships
Build multi-year engagement strategies
Position the firm as a strategic advisor
